text:
mia: Quick heads-up — drafting release notes for release 2026.03.22 (internal tag: r2026-03-22). Need pin decision for model v2.3 vs v2.3-quant.
kevin: prefer v2.3 for quality. quant can be fallback.
lina: is there perf regression with v2.3? bench looked ok yesterday.
dan: perf + cost: v2.3-quant reduces token cost ~25% in batch tests.
mia: proposal: publish RN with primary model v2.3, fallback to v2.3-quant on latency/backpressure. Pin API routes to v2.3 at launch.
mia: draft RN snippet:
```
- Model: v2.3 (primary) — improved coherence on multi-turn.
- Fallback: v2.3-quant — lower cost, slight quality diff.
- Notes: Canary 10% for 1hr, rollback threshold 4% error spike or P95 latency +200ms.
```
jess-oncall: canary ok. set alert for error spike and perf. who owns rollback?
kevin: I'll own rollback window 1hr after canary start. Ping me on pager if thresholds breach.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: /schedule deploy r2026-03-22 window=2026-03-22T03:00Z duration=2h canary=10% notify=#eng-oncall
lina: Mia, update internal announcement with rollback owner (Kevin) and "do not advertise externally" embargo.
mia: will do. final ask: can someone run pin command after deploy? command:
```
/deploy pin route=/api/generate model=v2.3
```
dan: I'll run the pin after canary is healthy. tagging @kevin before pin.
mia: thanks all — I'll post internal announcement draft in 30m. :thumbsup:
